# Guilds reference

The guild component, the stored guild data, the persistence seam and the server-side guild service. For how to use it, see [Guilds](../modules/guilds.md).

## VtUnitGuild

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Guilds → VtUnitGuild**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

A player's view of and hands on its guild. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useGuild`; needs a `VtPlayerIdentity` on the same object, because guild membership belongs to the player id, not the unit.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string PlayerId { get; }` | The player id guild membership is keyed on, or empty without an identity. |
| `VtGuildRecord Guild { get; }` | The player's guild, or null. |
| `bool InGuild { get; }` | True while the player belongs to a guild. |
| `VtGuildMember Member { get; }` | The player's roster entry, or null. |
| `event Action<VtGuildRecord> OnGuildChanged` | Fires when the player's guild changed, was joined, left or disbanded. Null means no guild. |
| `event Action<VtGuildInvite> OnInviteReceived` | Fires when an invite arrives. |
| `event Action OnInviteCleared` | Fires when the pending invite was accepted, declined or expired. |
| `bool HasPermission(VtGuildPermissions permission)` | True when the player's rank allows `permission`. |
| `bool TryGetInvite(out VtGuildInvite invite)` | The pending invite, if any. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings, hook guild chat and listen to the guild service and the player identity. Idempotent; call it again after adding a `VtPlayerIdentity` late. |
| `bool CreateGuild(string guildName, string tag, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Found a guild, paying the definition's Guild Creation Cost. |
| `bool Invite(string playerNameOrId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Invite the online player with this name or id. |
| `bool AcceptInvite(out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Join the guild that invited this player. |
| `bool DeclineInvite()` | Turn down the pending invite. |
| `bool Leave(out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Leave the guild. |
| `bool Kick(string memberPlayerId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Remove a lower-ranked member. |
| `bool Promote(string memberPlayerId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Move a lower-ranked member up one rank. |
| `bool Demote(string memberPlayerId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Move a lower-ranked member down one rank. |
| `bool TransferLeadership(string memberPlayerId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Hand leadership to a member. |
| `bool SetMotd(string text, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Change the message of the day. |
| `bool Disband(out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | End the guild. Leader only. |
| `void ApplyGuildFromNet(VtGuildRecord guild)` | Replace this player's view of its guild. Used by replication; not authority-gated. Null means no guild. |
| `void ApplyInviteFromNet(VtGuildInvite invite, bool pending)` | Replace this player's pending invite. Used by replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtGuildRecord

Serializable class.

A guild as stored: identity, ranks and roster. Plain data that serializes with `JsonUtility`; change it only through `VtGuilds`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Guild Id (`guildId`) | `string` | Empty | Unique id generated when the guild is founded. |
| Name (`name`) | `string` | Empty | Guild name, unique ignoring case. |
| Tag (`tag`) | `string` | Empty | Short tag of 2 to 5 letters or digits, stored uppercase. |
| Motd (`motd`) | `string` | Empty | Message of the day shown to members. |
| Created At (`createdAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the guild was founded, in UTC seconds since 1970. |
| Ranks (`ranks`) | List of [VtGuildRank](#vtguildrank) | Empty | Ranks from highest to lowest. Index 0 is the leader. |
| Members (`members`) | List of [VtGuildMember](#vtguildmember) | Empty | Every member, online or not. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string LeaderId { get; }` | The leader's player id, or null. |
| `VtGuildMember FindMember(string playerId)` | The member with `playerId`, or null. |
| `VtGuildRank GetRank(int index)` | The rank at `index`, or null. |
| `bool HasPermission(string playerId, VtGuildPermissions permission)` | True when the member may do `permission`. The leader may do everything. |

## VtGuildMember

Serializable class.

One member of a guild, online or not.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Stable player id of the member. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty | The member's name when last seen. |
| Rank (`rank`) | `int` | 0 | Index into the guild's ranks. 0 is the leader; a higher index is a lower rank. |
| Joined At (`joinedAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the member joined, in UTC seconds since 1970. |
| Last Seen At (`lastSeenAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the member was last seen online, in UTC seconds since 1970. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsOnline { get; }` | True while the member's player identity is online in this process. |

## VtGuildRank

Serializable class.

A rank name and its permissions.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name (`name`) | `string` | Empty | Rank name shown on the roster. |
| Permissions (`permissions`) | [VtGuildPermissions](#vtguildpermissions) | `None` | What members of this rank may do. The leader rank may do everything regardless. |

## VtGuildInvite

Serializable struct.

A pending invite to a guild.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Guild Id (`guildId`) | `string` | Empty | Id of the inviting guild. |
| Guild Name (`guildName`) | `string` | Empty | Name of the inviting guild. |
| Inviter Id (`inviterId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the member who sent the invite. |
| Inviter Name (`inviterName`) | `string` | Empty | Name of the member who sent the invite. |
| Expires At (`expiresAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the invite runs out, in UTC seconds since 1970. |

## IVtGuildStore

Interface. Implemented by [VtJsonGuildStore](#vtjsonguildstore), `VtMemoryGuildStore`.

Where guilds persist. `VtGuilds` keeps every guild in memory and calls `Save` after each change, so an implementation may write asynchronously. The package ships an in-memory store and `VtJsonGuildStore`; an online game implements this against its database.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `IEnumerable<VtGuildRecord> LoadAll()` | Every stored guild, read once when the service loads. |
| `void Save(VtGuildRecord guild)` | Persist the current state of `guild`. |
| `void Delete(string guildId)` | Remove a disbanded guild. |

## VtJsonGuildStore

Class.

Stores each guild as a JSON file in a folder. Suits single-player, a listen server or a small dedicated server; an online game with several servers needs a database behind `IVtGuildStore` instead.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string Folder { get; }` | The folder guild files live in. |
| `IEnumerable<VtGuildRecord> LoadAll()` | Every guild file in the folder. Empty when the folder does not exist yet. |
| `void Save(VtGuildRecord guild)` | Write the guild to its own JSON file, creating the folder when needed. |
| `void Delete(string guildId)` | Delete the guild's file. |

## VtGuilds

Static class.

The guild service. Owns every guild on the authority: creation, invites, membership, ranks, the message of the day and disbanding, and persists each change through `Store`. Players reach it through `VtUnitGuild`; server code and tools may call it directly with player ids, which works for offline members too.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IVtGuildStore Store { get; set; }` | Where guilds persist. Setting it reloads every guild from the new store. |
| `static Func<double> Clock { get; set; }` | Wall-clock seconds used for invites and member times. Null restores UTC time. |
| `static IReadOnlyCollection<VtGuildRecord> All { get; }` | Every guild. |
| `static event Action<VtGuildRecord> OnGuildChanged` | Fires after a guild was created or changed: roster, ranks, names or message of the day. |
| `static event Action<VtGuildRecord> OnGuildDisbanded` | Fires after a guild was disbanded, with its last state. |
| `static event Action<string, string> OnMembershipChanged` | Fires when a player joined or left a guild: (player id, guild id or null). |
| `static event Action<string, VtGuildInvite, bool> OnInviteChanged` | Fires when a player's pending invite was set or cleared: (player id, invite, pending). |
| `static Func<string, bool> NameFilterFn` | Refuse a guild name for reasons beyond the built-in rules, such as a word list. Return false to refuse. |
| `static VtGuildRecord FindById(string guildId)` | The guild with `guildId`, or null. |
| `static VtGuildRecord FindByName(string name)` | The guild named `name` ignoring case, or null. |
| `static VtGuildRecord GuildOf(string playerId)` | The guild `playerId` belongs to, or null. |
| `static bool TryGetInvite(string playerId, out VtGuildInvite invite)` | The unexpired invite waiting for `playerId`. |
| `static void Reload()` | Drop every guild and invite from memory and load again from the store. |
| `static bool Create(string founderId, string founderName, string name, string tag, out VtGuildRecord guild, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Found a guild with `founderId` as leader. |
| `static bool Invite(string inviterId, string targetId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Invite `targetId` to the inviter's guild. Replaces an older invite. |
| `static bool Accept(string playerId, string displayName, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Join the guild that invited `playerId`. |
| `static bool Decline(string playerId)` | Turn down a pending invite. False when there is none. |
| `static bool Leave(string playerId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Leave the guild. A leader with other members must hand over leadership first; a leader alone disbands the guild. |
| `static bool Kick(string actorId, string targetId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Remove `targetId`. Needs Kick and a higher rank than the target. |
| `static bool Promote(string actorId, string targetId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Move `targetId` one rank up, never to leader. Needs Promote and a rank at least two above the target. |
| `static bool Demote(string actorId, string targetId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Move `targetId` one rank down. Needs Promote and a higher rank than the target. |
| `static bool TransferLeadership(string actorId, string targetId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Make `targetId` the leader; the old leader becomes the next rank. Leader only. |
| `static bool SetMotd(string actorId, string text, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | Set the message of the day, cleaned like chat and capped at `VtTuning.guildMotdMaxLength`. Needs Edit Motd. |
| `static bool Disband(string actorId, out VtGuildFailureReason reason)` | End the guild and free every member. Leader only. |
| `static void TouchMember(string playerId, string displayName)` | Record a member's current display name and last-seen time. Called when a player logs in or renames. |
| `static bool IsValidName(string name)` | True when `name` passes the length, character and filter rules. |
| `static void EnsureChatHook()` | Route guild chat through the guild roster. Called by `VtUnitGuild`; call it yourself in a headless server. |
| `static void ResetState()` | Clear memory, invites and seams, and return to an empty in-memory store. |

## Enums

### VtGuildPermissions

What a guild rank may do. Rank 0 is the leader and may do everything.

Flags: values can be combined.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | No permissions. |
| `Invite` | Invite players. |
| `Kick` | Remove members of a lower rank. |
| `Promote` | Promote and demote members of a lower rank. |
| `EditMotd` | Change the message of the day. |
| `All` | Every permission. |

### VtGuildFailureReason

Why a guild call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `AlreadyInGuild` | The player already belongs to a guild. |
| `NotInGuild` | The player belongs to no guild. |
| `NameInvalid` | The name is too short, too long, or has characters other than letters, digits and single spaces. |
| `NameTaken` | Another guild has this name. |
| `TagInvalid` | The tag is not 2 to 5 letters or digits. |
| `CannotAfford` | The founder cannot pay the creation cost. |
| `NoPermission` | The player's rank lacks the permission. |
| `TargetNotFound` | No online player by that name or id. |
| `TargetInGuild` | The invited player already belongs to a guild. |
| `TargetNotMember` | The player acted on is not a member of this guild. |
| `GuildFull` | The guild has `VtTuning.guildMaxMembers` members. |
| `NoInvite` | No invite is pending, or it expired. |
| `RankTooLow` | The target's rank is not below the acting member's. |
| `LeaderCannotLeave` | The leader must hand over leadership before leaving a guild with other members. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
